verdict.rationale: Ashby documents an official MCP server that makes live recruiting context available to MCP-compatible clients such as ChatGPT, Claude and Cursor without custom middleware. Its documented scope covers search and retrieval across candidates, applications, jobs, interviews, offers, notes, feedback and more, and a probe confirmed the official product page exists. Missing for 10: connection/setup and authentication documentation for the MCP server, clarity on whether write actions are exposed beyond search/retrieve, independent or hands-on corroboration.
